subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word from the given options.**

My grandmother, a __pious__ lady, died peacefully in her village.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Devout**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The synonym of "pious" is "devout".
 
• **Pious **means a deeply religious or devout attitude, characterized by a strong devotion to religious beliefs and practices. (धर्मनिष्ठ)
 
 
• **Example**: *The elderly woman, with her pious demeanour, attended the temple every Sunday without fail. *
 
 
 
• Marked option **Devout **means deeply religious or devoted to a particular religion or belief. (धार्मिक)
 
 
• **Example**: *She is a devout follower of Buddhism.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Envious **means feeling or showing envy. (ईर्ष्या करनेवाला)
 
• **Attractive **means pleasing or appealing to the senses. (आकर्षक)
 
• **Gallant **means brave or heroic. (बहादुर)
